```{r load_Shorthouse_data}

```

```{r}
shorthouse_intensities <- Shorthouse_2022_extended$data_matrix
shorthouse_samples <- Shorthouse_2022_extended$samples
shorthouse_features <- Shorthouse_2022_extended$features

# create mutation_tokens column from mutated_genes in samples
shorthouse_samples_working <-
    shorthouse_samples %>%
    mutate(
        mutation_tokens = mutated_genes %>%
            as.character() %>%
            coalesce("") %>%
            str_replace_all("\\s*[;+]\\s*", ";") %>%
            strsplit(split = ";", fixed = TRUE) %>%
            sapply(function(tokens) {
                cleaned_tokens <-
                    tokens %>%
                    str_trim() %>%
                    str_to_upper() %>%
                    (\(x) x[x != ""])() %>%
                    unique()

                if (length(cleaned_tokens) == 0) {
                    NA_character_
                } else {
                    paste(cleaned_tokens, collapse = "; ")
                }
            })
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        is_lung_cell_line = case_when(
            general_site == "Lung/Pleura" ~ TRUE,
            TRUE ~ FALSE
        ),
        has_KRAS_mutation = case_when(
            str_detect(mutation_tokens, "(^|;\\s*)KRAS($|;)") ~ TRUE,
            TRUE ~ FALSE
        )
    )

Shorthouse_2022_extended$samples <- shorthouse_samples_working
save(Shorthouse_2022_extended, file = "../data/Shorthouse_2022_extended.RData")

samples_lung <- shorthouse_samples_working %>%
    filter(is_lung_cell_line)

samples_lung_KRAS <- samples_lung %>%
    filter(has_KRAS_mutation)

samples_lung_NO_KRAS <- samples_lung %>%
    filter(!has_KRAS_mutation)


```

```{r}
# investigate mutation co-occurrence with alluvial plots

top_n_genes <- 20L

build_alluvial_objects <- function(sample_df, cohort_label, anchor_gene = NULL, top_n = 6L) {
    mutation_long <-
        sample_df %>%
        select(name, mutation_tokens) %>%
        mutate(mutation_tokens = coalesce(mutation_tokens, "")) %>%
        separate_rows(mutation_tokens, sep = "\\s*;\\s*") %>%
        mutate(mutation_tokens = str_trim(mutation_tokens)) %>%
        filter(mutation_tokens != "", !is.na(mutation_tokens)) %>%
        distinct(name, mutation_tokens)

    partner_counts <- mutation_long

    if (!is.null(anchor_gene)) {
        partner_counts <- partner_counts %>%
            filter(mutation_tokens != anchor_gene)
    }

    partner_counts <- partner_counts %>%
        count(mutation_tokens, sort = TRUE, name = "n_samples")

    top_partners <- partner_counts %>%
        slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
        pull(mutation_tokens)

    if (length(top_partners) == 0) {
        return(list(
            partner_counts = partner_counts,
            top_partners = top_partners,
            plot = NULL
        ))
    }

    alluvial_wide <-
        mutation_long %>%
        filter(mutation_tokens %in% top_partners) %>%
        mutate(value = TRUE) %>%
        pivot_wider(
            names_from = mutation_tokens,
            values_from = value,
            values_fill = FALSE
        ) %>%
        right_join(sample_df %>% select(name), by = "name") %>%
        mutate(across(-name, ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)))

    gene_levels <- top_partners

    if (!is.null(anchor_gene)) {
        alluvial_wide <- alluvial_wide %>%
            mutate(!!anchor_gene := TRUE)
        gene_levels <- c(anchor_gene, top_partners)
    }

    alluvial_df <-
        alluvial_wide %>%
        pivot_longer(
            cols = -name,
            names_to = "gene",
            values_to = "mutated"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
            mutated = if_else(mutated, "Mutated", "Wildtype"),
            gene = factor(gene, levels = gene_levels)
        ) %>%
        count(name, gene, mutated, name = "Freq")

    subtitle_text <- paste0(
        "Top ",
        length(top_partners),
        if (!is.null(anchor_gene)) {
            paste0(" genes co-mutated with ", anchor_gene)
        } else {
            " mutated genes in this cohort"
        }
    )

    plot_obj <-
        ggplot(
            alluvial_df,
            aes(
                x = gene,
                stratum = mutated,
                alluvium = name,
                y = Freq,
                fill = mutated,
                label = mutated
            )
        ) +
        geom_flow(alpha = 0.45, width = 0.2, color = "grey70") +
        geom_stratum(width = 0.35, color = "grey35") +
        geom_text(stat = "stratum", size = 3) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(Mutated = "#C44E52", Wildtype = "#4C72B0")) +
        labs(
            title = paste0(cohort_label, " mutation co-occurrence"),
            subtitle = subtitle_text,
            x = NULL,
            y = "Number of lung cell lines",
            fill = NULL
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
            panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "top"
        )

    list(
        partner_counts = partner_counts,
        top_partners = top_partners,
        plot = plot_obj
    )
}

kras_alluvial_obj <- build_alluvial_objects(
    sample_df = samples_lung_KRAS,
    cohort_label = "KRAS-mutant lung cell lines",
    anchor_gene = "KRAS",
    top_n = top_n_genes
)

no_kras_alluvial_obj <- build_alluvial_objects(
    sample_df = samples_lung_NO_KRAS,
    cohort_label = "Non-KRAS lung cell lines",
    top_n = top_n_genes
)

all_lung_alluvial_obj <- build_alluvial_objects(
    sample_df = samples_lung,
    cohort_label = "All lung cell lines",
    top_n = top_n_genes
)

if (!is.null(kras_alluvial_obj$plot)) {
    print(kras_alluvial_obj$plot)
} else {
    message("No KRAS co-mutations detected in KRAS-mutant lung cell lines.")
}

kras_alluvial_obj$partner_counts

if (!is.null(no_kras_alluvial_obj$plot)) {
    print(no_kras_alluvial_obj$plot)
} else {
    message("No recurrent mutations detected in non-KRAS lung cell lines.")
}

no_kras_alluvial_obj$partner_counts

if (!is.null(all_lung_alluvial_obj$plot)) {
    print(all_lung_alluvial_obj$plot)
} else {
    message("No recurrent mutations detected across all lung cell lines.")
}

all_lung_alluvial_obj$partner_counts
```
